description: This PHP source file defines the 'Membership' display field class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It extends 'ListableDisplayField' and provides specific implementations for methods to retrieve the DTO class, entity aliases, and fields related to membership reporting.

classes.name: Membership
classes.description: Represents a display field for membership data in reports, extending ListableDisplayField to specify DTO class, entity aliases, and relevant fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the DTO class associated with this display field, specifically 'Membership' DTO.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in queries, here returning ['membership'].

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of fields related to the display, here returning 'employee.empNumber'.
